name: local_run
description: Runs a command on the user's desktop, including during an SSH session, only after this exact command and working directory are approved in Cursor. Use Shell for commands in the current workspace.

cwd.description: Absolute desktop directory; defaults to the desktop home.

name: browser_nav
description: Operate the tab the user shared in the paired desktop Chrome extension. New or navigated pages must stay on the shared development origin.

name: browser_act
description: Run ordered desktop browser actions using {action,selector,text,key,x,y} steps: click, input, key, scroll, wait, or dialog. Click/input/wait take CSS selectors; dialog uses accept and text.

name: browser_read
description: Snapshot visible text and controls, screenshot, or evaluate JavaScript in the user-shared development tab. Optional annotate displays CSS selector boxes on screenshots.

name: browser_network
description: Read recent network activity, redacted request/response details, HAR metadata, or WebSocket frame metadata for the shared tab. Request detail takes id.

name: browser_performance
description: Read navigation timing, browser vitals, or start/stop recording timing events associated with the shared tab's top frame.

name: browser_memory
description: Read heap/DOM metrics and available detached nodes. Snapshot stores a baseline of counters for compare.

name: browser_debug
description: Pause, resume, step, inspect current scope, set a breakpoint with a condition, or remove it. URL and one-based line select the breakpoint. Use state for call frames and variables.

name: browser_sources
description: List and read scripts by CDP id. Original reads the source map's original paths, or its embedded source if given path.

name: browser_element
description: Inspect an element matching a CSS selector, including the box model, computed and matched CSS rules, and event listeners.

name: browser_emulate
description: Set device viewport, dark scheme, offline and slow network, CPU throttle, timezone, locale, geolocation or vision emulation. Supply only fields to update.

name: browser_coverage
description: Start or stop CSS rule-usage tracking and return per-stylesheet coverage.

name: browser_intercept
description: Set or clear one exact URL interception on the shared development origin. Modes block, mock, or delay. Mock takes status and body. Delay takes milliseconds.

name: browser_storage
description: List storage keys, database and cache names, service workers, and cookie metadata for the shared origin, with secret values excluded.

name: browser_history
description: Read the bounded local log of shared-tab navigation, requests and console events.

name: browser_steps
description: Start or stop recording clicks and form changes in the shared Chrome tab, then replay saved steps on the same development origin.
